info.name: Cross_Border_Command — Zoho Books Sync (P2P + Sales)
info.description: All app endpoints that push records into Zoho Books, folder-wise, with data + curl. Set collection variables base_url (default http://127.0.0.1:8000; prod https://cbc.idims.in) and token (Sanctum bearer from POST /api/login). Every sync needs Zoho Books connected on the server (ZOHO_BOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN + ZOHO_BOOKS_ORG_ID in .env) else it returns 503. See ZOHO_BOOKS_FLOW.md for the end-to-end flow, prerequisites, and error matrix.

exec: var j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { return; }

request.description:
Email + password login → `{ token, user }`. The test script stores the token into {{token}} for every other request.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d '{"email":"igcceo@mailinator.com","password":"Secret@123"}'

item.name: 01 · Purchase Order → Zoho Purchase Order
item.description: Flow: cut TDS once → record payments until the PO balance is cleared → SYNC (creates the Zoho Purchase Order + caches its PDF). e-sign is NOT required (removed 2026-07-17). Idempotent + locked; edit/delete blocked after sync.

request.description:
`PoPaymentController@summary` — base/GST/TDS/net-payable/amount-paid/balance + payment history for the PO.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/6/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`PoPaymentController@saveTds` — one-time TDS % on the base (Total PO − GST). 422 if already cut. Must run before any payment.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/6/payment-summary/tds -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tds_percentage":2}'

`PoPaymentController@store` — record ONE payment against the PO (multipart, optional proof). 422 before TDS is cut, or if amount exceeds the outstanding balance. On sync these payments become Zoho vendor payments applied to the bill.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/6/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=396169.67 -F bank_name=HDFC -F utr_cheque_number=UTR-0001 -F status=Cleared -F attachment=@/path/to/proof.pdf

`PurchaseOrderController@sync` — push the PO to Zoho Books as a Purchase Order (no body). Guards: 503 unconfigured · 409 concurrent · already-synced → idempotent · 422 no vendor / no items / not fully paid. Registered vendor → forward GST; intra vs inter state → CGST+SGST vs IGST.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/6/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`PurchaseOrderController@zohoPdf` — stream Zoho's own rendered PO PDF (tenant-scoped cache path). 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/6/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-po.pdf

item.name: 02 · Supplier Invoice → Zoho Bill
item.description: Flow: fully utilise the payable (With-PO SPI → pay through the linked PO; Direct SPI → cut TDS + pay the SPI) → SYNC. Sync creates the Zoho Bill from the line items + taxes, posts the payments as vendor payments (bank-matched, capped at the bill balance), and caches the PDF. Re-sync tops up any payment that failed. TDS stays as an open balance on the Zoho bill (by design).

request.description:
`SpiPaymentController@summary` — Direct-SPI payment popup (base/GST/TDS/net/paid/balance). A With-PO SPI pays through its PO instead (folder 01).

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/1/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

`SpiPaymentController@saveTds` — one-time TDS on a Direct SPI.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/1/payment-summary/tds -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tds_percentage":5}'

`SpiPaymentController@store` — pay a Direct SPI (multipart). 422 before TDS / over-balance.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/1/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=11800 -F bank_name=SBI -F utr_cheque_number=UTR-SPI-1 -F status=Cleared

`SupplierPurchaseInvoiceController@sync` — create the Zoho Bill + apply the recorded payments as vendor payments (no body). Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent (re-sync tops up unposted payments) · 422 no vendor / no items / not fully utilised. Message flags TDS residual + any payment that could not post.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/1/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`SupplierPurchaseInvoiceController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Bill PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/1/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-bill.pdf

item.name: 03 · Debit Note → Zoho Vendor Credit
item.description: A debit note REDUCES the payable, so it maps to a Zoho Vendor Credit (NOT a bill). The linked SPI must already be synced as a bill (its bill_id is sent at creation — this org enforces it). Sync creates the vendor credit AND applies it against the linked bill (capped at the bill's open + un-recovered balance). Re-sync retries the apply.

request.description:
`DebitNotePaymentController@summary` — recovery popup (total/recovered/balance + history).

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

`DebitNotePaymentController@store` — record an amount recovered against the debit note (multipart). 422 over-recovery. The recovered slice is NOT applied to the Zoho bill (avoids double-count).

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=500 -F bank_name=HDFC -F reference_no=REC-1 -F status=Cleared

item.name: POST {id}/sync  → Zoho Vendor Credit (+ apply to bill)

request.description:
`DebitNoteController@sync` — create a Zoho Vendor Credit (bill_id = linked SPI's bill) and apply it to that bill (no body). Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent (re-sync retries the apply) · 422 no vendor / no items / linked SPI not yet synced.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`DebitNoteController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho vendor-credit PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-vc.pdf

item.name: 04 · Quotation → Zoho Estimate
item.description: Sales side. Sync creates a Zoho Estimate from the quotation's line items (customer created once + deduped). Zoho auto-numbers the estimate; our QT code rides on reference_number. Forward GST always applies on a sale; inter-state IGST only for a GST-registered customer.

request.description:
`QuotationController@sync` — push the quotation to Zoho Books as an Estimate (no body). Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent · 422 no customer / no items. Edit/delete blocked after sync.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/sales/quotations/13/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`QuotationController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Estimate PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/sales/quotations/13/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-estimate.pdf

item.name: 05 · Proforma Invoice → Zoho Invoice
item.description: Sales side. Sync creates a Zoho Invoice from the PI's line items (same customer/product dedup + GST rules as the estimate). Zoho auto-numbers the invoice; our INV code rides on reference_number.

request.description:
`ProformaInvoiceController@sync` — push the PI to Zoho Books as an Invoice (no body). Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent · 422 no customer / no items. Edit/delete blocked after sync.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/sales/proforma-invoices/10/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`ProformaInvoiceController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Invoice PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/sales/proforma-invoices/10/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-invoice.pdf
